name: Praying For A Sign
overview: Scripture reveals a complex perspective on praying for a sign, showing both the desire for divine confirmation and the danger of seeking signs for the wrong reasons. Gideon’s request for a sign demonstrates faith in God’s promise to save Israel, while the psalmist asks for a token of God’s goodness to bring glory to the Lord. Isaiah encourages asking boldly for a sign from God, yet Jesus rebukes those who demand signs out of unbelief, declaring that no sign will be given except the sign of Jonah. Ultimately, the call is to persistent prayer and trust in God’s timing rather than a continual demand for miraculous proof.
